mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_usage (tenant_id, user_id, session_id, message_id, agent_id, agent_name, app_name, invocation_id, provider, model_version, prompt_tokens, candidate_tokens, total_tokens, thoughts_tokens, tool_use_prompt_tokens, trace_id, metadata) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{appName}, #{invocationId}, #{provider}, #{modelVersion}, #{promptTokens}, #{candidateTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{thoughtsTokens}, #{toolUsePromptTokens}, #{traceId}, #{metadata})

INSERT INTO model_usage (tenant_id, user_id, session_id, run_id, call_id, message_id, agent_id, agent_name, app_name, invocation_id, provider, model_version, usage_type, call_status, finish_reason, prompt_tokens, candidate_tokens, total_tokens, thoughts_tokens, tool_use_prompt_tokens, trace_id, metadata) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{runId}, #{callId}, #{messageId}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{appName}, #{invocationId}, #{provider}, #{modelVersion}, #{usageType}, #{callStatus}, #{finishReason}, #{promptTokens}, #{candidateTokens}, COALESCE(#{totalTokens}, 0), #{thoughtsTokens}, #{toolUsePromptTokens}, #{traceId}, #{metadata}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call_status = IF(call_status IN ('success', 'failed', 'cancelled'), call_status, VALUES(call_status)), finish_reason = COALESCE(finish_reason, VALUES(finish_reason)), prompt_tokens = GREATEST(COALESCE(prompt_tokens, 0), COALESCE(VALUES(prompt_tokens), 0)), candidate_tokens = GREATEST(COALESCE(candidate_tokens, 0), COALESCE(VALUES(candidate_tokens), 0)), total_tokens = GREATEST(total_tokens, VALUES(total_tokens)), thoughts_tokens = GREATEST(COALESCE(thoughts_tokens, 0), COALESCE(VALUES(thoughts_tokens), 0)), tool_use_prompt_tokens = GREATEST(COALESCE(tool_use_prompt_tokens, 0), COALESCE(VALUES(tool_use_prompt_tokens), 0)), model_version = IF(VALUES(model_version) IS NULL OR VALUES(model_version) IN ('', 'unknown'), model_version, VALUES(model_version)), trace_id = COALESCE(trace_id, VALUES(trace_id))

mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status='success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status='failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(candidate_tokens), 0) AS candidate_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(thoughts_tokens), 0) AS thoughts_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(tool_use_prompt_tokens), 0) AS tool_use_prompt_tokens
